surface: The date editor, a native date input over the cell: opening it, typing a date, Enter committing it, and Escape cancelling a second edit.

steps.note: Enter opens the editor on the Start cell (`6/10/24`) and focuses its native date input, which holds 2024-06-10. Required: the control, in the reader's words; VoiceOver reads a segment of the input as a `month stepper`. The input has no name (the axe baseline's `editor-input-names`). Finding: nothing is said when the date editor opens, on every reader.

Eight digits fill the segments of the input: the same digits for month-day-year and day-month-year order (01/01/2020). Nothing is required: a reader speaks a segment's new value in its own words (VoiceOver `2020 Year stepper`, NVDA nothing).

Enter commits the date and moves the selection one row down (enterMoves), to the next row's Start, drawn as `1/5/24`. Required: that cell's value and its row. Finding: the focus stays on the closed date input, so NVDA says nothing and VoiceOver reads a stepper of the hidden input (`1 month stepper`, `2024 Year stepper`).

ArrowUp moves to the edited cell, drawn as `1/1/20`; the arrow key takes the focus from the closed input to the cell. Finding: only VoiceOver with Chromium reads it; NVDA and VoiceOver with WebKit say nothing.
The editor opens again, on the new value. Finding: NVDA says nothing; VoiceOver reads the month stepper.

Escape closes the editor without a change. Finding: nothing is said on any reader, and the focus stays on the closed input, as the commit leaves it; grid-core records the same silence for the text editor.
